comment: init without any deps must error
init with log but no timer/handlers deps must error
only the hdb is connected when the gateway starts
init with the hdb up and the rdb down
the connected hdb is registered into di.serverselect at init
the rdb was down at init so it is not routable
init installs the .servers.connectcustom hook di.torq.servers fires on a new connection
the rdb connects after startup - di.torq.servers' retry has reconnected it
di.torq.servers' retryrows fires the hook with the connected rows
REGRESSION: a backend that connected after startup becomes routable without a restart
